warnings.title: PBKDF2 Iteration Dynamic Benchmark Calibration Requirement
warnings.description: ADR-0011 specifies a fixed value of 100,000 PBKDF2 iterations rather than dynamic runtime benchmark calibration.
warnings.whyItMatters: Fixed iteration counts may become suboptimal on modern hardware or slow low-power platforms.
warnings.requiredRepair: Include implementation-time benchmark calibration for PBKDF2 iterations in WAVE_1 finance tasks.

warnings.title: External Calendar Adapter Network Sandbox Isolation Requirement
warnings.description: ADR-0013 specifies external calendar adapter boundaries but requires strict network sandbox isolation and offline fallback gating.
warnings.whyItMatters: External calendar adapters must never leak local mind map data or bypass offline privacy rules.
warnings.requiredRepair: Enforce strict network sandbox isolation and disabled-by-default runtime flags for external calendar adapters.
